description: CALL THIS when you have a track ID or exact title and need the full record: credits, genres, moods, tempo, licensing status, links. Usually follows a search. Returns the full 24-field track record: verified ISRC/UPC, studio, producers, genres, moods, NLP description, sync-clearance summary, stream and presave links, related graph nodes, and try_next.

id_or_title.description: Track title (exact or partial) or a Spotify track ID / open.spotify.com URL.

name: get_track

outputSchema.description: get_track response: full 24-field track record plus summary_markdown, related_nodes, try_next.

_session.description: Chain session: pass _session.session_token back in the next call to continue the chain.

session_token.description: Hex session token; echo it as params._session.session_token to continue.

step.description: Hop number in this chain (1 = chain start).

description.description: 150-300 word NLP prose (Whisper-derived where flagged; not proofread).

related_nodes.description: Up to 8 connected knowledge-graph node IDs.

signature.description: That Boy Hi Hat flow-architecture signature block (present on his tracks).

summary_markdown.description: Compact markdown: title, ISRC/UPC, studio, genres/moods, one-line sync clearance.

try_next.description: Suggested follow-up calls, each a pre-compiled {tool, arguments, purpose} payload.

items.description: Pre-compiled next call: copy `arguments` straight into the next tools/call.

arguments.description: Ready-to-use arguments, pre-populated from the current response.

purpose.description: Why this call is the natural next step.
